behavior: Several triggers can join an open popup that allows an implicit trigger without any of them claiming it. A mount of triggers that claim nothing does this, and so does an activation by `KeepAlive`. The popup then takes the first trigger of its map that is in the document. Base UI takes a trigger there only when it is the only one. Base UI has no counterpart of `KeepAlive`. A trigger that mounts while `KeepAlive` holds its branch stays hidden in the map until the activation, and it claims no popup. A shown trigger can thus claim an open popup before the held trigger activates. A root that mounts while `KeepAlive` holds its branch picks its trigger at the activation.
